purpose.title: Bridging the gap between modern financial engineering and humanitarian mission.
purpose.p1: Commercial SaaS companies build tools for profit-driven e-commerce. Nonprofits, however, have fundamentally different needs: complex multi-year child sponsorships, community water well pools, strict statutory tax deduction receipts, and safeguarding standards for vulnerable beneficiaries.
purpose.p2: When charities are forced to stitch together 5 different generic tools—a payment processor, a mailing list tool, a spreadsheet, and an offline donor database—hours are lost and supporters slip away.
purpose.p3Before: Donorfit brings these operations into one cohesive, European-compliant platform. The result?
purpose.p3Bold: Less administrative work. Stronger donor relationships. More impact.

items.q: What is Donorfit and how can it benefit us?
items.a: Donorfit is a fundraising platform that helps nonprofits collect donations, manage donors, track interactions and personalise outreach — so you can increase giving and keep supporters engaged for longer.

items.q: How easy is it to set up and use Donorfit?
items.a: Getting started takes three steps: configure your cause settings, connect a payment gateway, and add the donation box to your website.

items.q: What are the payment options available for donation in Donorfit?
items.a: Donorfit supports more than 15 donation payment methods through payment gateways such as Stripe, GoCardless, Mollie and PayPal.

items.q: Can I accept international donations with Donorfit?
items.a: Yes. Through the same payment gateways you can accept contributions in more than 135 currencies.

closing.title: Keep more of every donation for your mission.
closing.text: No platform fee. No transaction fee. Start collecting donations today.

hero.title: Security, Privacy, and Data Protection at Donorfit
hero.intro: Nonprofits protect vulnerable communities and steward generous public support. We hold ourselves to the highest standards of transparency, data privacy, and technological resilience.

sovereignty.title: European Data Sovereignty
sovereignty.text: All core application infrastructure and relational databases are hosted strictly inside the European Union. We do not transfer non-profit supporter databases or beneficiary dossiers to foreign jurisdictions without explicit adequacy safeguards.

access.title: Strict Access Controls
access.text: We employ strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), multi-factor authentication (MFA), and mandatory session timeouts. Your organization controls exactly which staff members, volunteers, or auditors can access specific records.

portability.title: Zero Lock-In & Portability
portability.text: You own your organization’s data completely. In accordance with GDPR Article 20, you can export full donor files, giving histories, and active direct debit mandates in standard open formats at any time.

architecture.title: Our Security Architecture & Infrastructure Safeguards
architecture.intro: We practice defense-in-depth across the application lifecycle to defend non-profit operations from unauthorized access, disruption, or data loss.

encryption.title: Encryption in Transit & at Rest
encryption.text: All data transmitted between browsers, mobile devices, and Donorfit servers is protected with Transport Layer Security (TLS 1.3). Sensitive databases and backup snapshots are encrypted using AES-256 standard encryption keys.

payments.title: Payment & Banking Rail Security
payments.text: Donations and recurring pledges are processed via PCI-DSS certified European payment facilitators. Bank direct debits follow European EPC SEPA Direct Debit scheme rules with validated IBAN checksums and cryptographically secure mandate IDs.

redundancy.title: Redundancy & Automated Backups
redundancy.text: Application state is continuously backed up with point-in-time recovery capabilities across isolated availability zones in the EU. Disaster recovery plans and data restoration simulations are conducted periodically.

safeguarding.title: Child & Beneficiary Safeguarding
safeguarding.text: For orphan and child sponsorship initiatives, sensitive location metrics and family identities are isolated behind strict role boundaries. Publicly visible profiles require affirmative consent logs and automated identifier redaction.

gdpr.title: GDPR Rights & Data Controller Alignment
gdpr.intro: Under European privacy legislation (EU Regulation 2016/679), your nonprofit acts as the Data Controller, and Donorfit functions as the Data Processor. We provide the technical tooling necessary for you to fulfill all statutory data subject rights.

rights.title: Right to Access (Art. 15)
rights.text: Generate comprehensive donor data dossiers with one click.

rights.title: Right to Erasure (Art. 17)
rights.text: Permanent data deletion tools while respecting statutory tax retention laws.

rights.title: Portability (Art. 20)
rights.text: Export clean, structured CSV and JSON packages without vendor lock-in.

rights.title: Consent Logs (Art. 7)
rights.text: Immutable timestamped records of communication and marketing opt-ins.

items.question: Where is Donorfit platform data physically hosted?
items.answer: All production databases, application servers, and backups are hosted within the European Union (Germany and Ireland) in ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2 Type II, and PCI-DSS compliant data center facilities. We maintain strict EU data sovereignty.

items.question: Does Donorfit store donor credit card numbers or banking passwords?
items.answer: No. Donorfit never stores raw credit card numbers or sensitive payment authentication credentials on our application servers. All payment handling is tokenized through certified Level 1 PCI-DSS payment gateways (such as Stripe and European banking direct debit rails).

items.question: How do you handle Data Processing Agreements (DPA)?
items.answer: Every nonprofit organization using Donorfit enters into a legally binding Data Processing Agreement (DPA) under Article 28 of the GDPR, with standardized technical and organizational measures (TOMs) clearly defined.

items.question: How do you protect sensitive child and beneficiary data in sponsorship programs?
items.answer: Sponsorship modules enforce strict role-based access control (RBAC). Field caseworkers, country directors, and finance teams have distinct permission boundaries. Sensitive records such as medical notes or exact guardian locations can be restricted so only authorized safeguarding officers can view them.

items.question: What is your incident response protocol?
items.answer: In the unlikely event of a security or data breach, our incident response plan requires notification to affected data controllers within 24 to 72 hours in strict alignment with GDPR statutory mandates, alongside immediate containment measures.
